To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DA and SSA have been demonstrated to be effective in shrinking prolactinomas.
DA and SSA have a relevant therapeutic role in patients with pituitary adenoma, but the extent of tumor shrinkage is highly dependent on the histotype of the adenoma.

1) DA and SSA are effective in inducing tumor shrinkage in prolactinomas, GH-secreting and TSH-secretions adenomas; 2) DA are also effective in inducing tumor reduction in ACTH-secretings adenomas; and 3) NFA do not respond to both DA and to SSA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effects of dopamine-agonist (DA) and somatostatin analogue (SSA) on tumor shrinkage of pituitary tumors.
the identification of molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of DA and SSA and with their potential application in patients with different subtypes of pituitary tumors.
a better understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of DA and SSA in patients with pituitary adenoma and with an improvement of the therapeutic approach to these tumors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DA and SSA are effective in inducing tumor shrinkage in most patients with prolactiomas, GH- and TTH-secreting adenoma and, to a limited extent, in those with ACTH-secting tumors.
DA and SSA are able to reduce tumor volume in patients with GH-, PRL-, and ACTH-secreating adenomas but the extent of tumor shrinkage is still limited in most patients.
DA are very effective in reducing tumor size in patients with macroprolactinoses while SSA are effective only in a limited number of patients with GH-secting adenomas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DA and SSA have a role in reducing tumor size in different histotypes of adenomas but that this effect is not as consistent as the one on hormonal secretion.
DA have been shown of efficacy in reducing tumor size in all types of pituitary tumors.
DA and SSA have been shown to reduce tumor size of pituitary macroadenomas.

DA and SSA can be used as first-line treatment in patients with pituitary adenoma.
